dimensions.assessment: Affects U.S. foreign policy operations regarding Moldova, specified sanctioned individuals, and bilateral diplomatic and economic relations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State shall facilitate a strategic dialogue between the United States and the Republic of Moldova

dimensions.assessment: Imposes strict statutory blocks on lifting existing sanctions against designated individuals and entities unless rigorous certification and briefing processes are met.
dimensions.evidence: any sanction imposed by the United States... may not be terminated until the Secretary of State and the Secretary of the Treasury have... submitted... a written certification

dimensions.assessment: References foreign assistance programs and economic support without specifying new monetary appropriations amounts.
dimensions.evidence: a list of active and cancelled foreign assistance programs in or related to Moldova since January 20, 2025

dimensions.assessment: Requires executive branch reporting, strategic plans, regular diplomatic dialogues, and restricts sanctions waiver authorities.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 30 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit to the appropriate Congressional Committees a report

dimensions.assessment: Includes a four-year strategy requirement and permanent restrictions on lifting specified sanctions until conditions are met.
dimensions.evidence: a 4-year strategy to-- (A) bolster United States-Moldovan bilateral relations

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts for authorized foreign assistance are not detailed in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Mandates strategic dialogues, a four-year foreign policy strategy report, and strict congressional certification requirements before terminating sanctions on specific individuals and entities.
